segments.title: 第116章 逆斬天驕
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 116: Slaying the Prodigies

"Go, go, go, let's hurry downstairs."

Right after the parent-teacher conference started, Zhu Yufei, who had just come out of the classroom, called over Zhang Guohuang, and the two of them bolted straight downstairs.

Because the report cards were sealed in file folders, they couldn't see them, and they were itching with curiosity.

Don't be fooled by these two clowns' usual unreliability; during the entrance exam at the start of the semester, they had both placed in the top five of the class.

Now, anxious as ever, they immediately ran to the bulletin board on the first floor, wanting to see their scores as soon as possible.

For good students, the school's ranking list often had a positive effect.

It was just like playing ranked matches in a video game.

Winning in competition, thereby gaining a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction, was in itself a driving force for continuous improvement.

For high school students, many might not truly understand the real meaning of learning so much knowledge every day.

But the rankings provided by their scores could at least offer a taste of victory, allowing them to savor the joy of learning.

Even if that joy came from competition.

Seeing Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang dash downstairs, the other students from Class 8 also rushed down.

And students from the other classes, after leaving their classrooms, also chose to gather at the bulletin board.

Shao Heqi was actually a bit anxious too, eager to know how he did on this exam.

But he was more concerned about his image and didn't want to be as impetuous as Zhu Yufei, which he found unseemly.

So he just walked amidst the crowd, slowly making his way to the first floor.

By now, a crowd was already gathered in front of the bulletin board, a sea of people as far as the eye could see.

Although Zhu Yufei and his friend had been early to head downstairs, they couldn't outpace the classes on the first floor who had the geographical advantage. They barely managed to secure a spot at the far-right end of the board.

"Xu Guangtao! I see you!" Zhang Guohuang shouted. "Rank 520 in the school! What a lucky number, your fated romance is coming!"

"Shut up, Zhang Guohuang!" Xu Guangtao, who was nearby, had a dark expression and quickly cut him off. "There's nothing to brag about with my rank, look at the ones higher up!"

"Don't be in such a hurry." Zhu Yufei squeezed a little to the left. "Big brothers, make some room! Please, let me have a look!"

Zhang Guohuang followed behind him, peered at the higher ranks, and then announced loudly: "Fang Chen! You're 439!"

"Zhou Juanling is 438, are you two stuck together?"

"Lin Yuan is 387, Xiuxiu is 352, Wei Chun is 327, Shao Heqi..."

Hearing his own name, Shao Heqi, outside the crowd, instantly perked up and pricked his ears.

Then he heard Zhang Guohuang shout: "280!"

Shao Heqi clenched his fists tightly.

In the last entrance exam, which only covered Chinese, Math, and English, he had ranked somewhere over 300 in the school. This time, with the addition of Physics and Chemistry, his strong suits, his total score had shot him straight into the top 300.

This ranking was exactly as he had expected.

And he knew that Li Luo's science scores weren't as good as his. If Li Luo's scores in the three main subjects were still at the same level as the entrance exam...

This time, he would definitely win!

Thinking of this, Shao Heqi was filled with anticipation, waiting for Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang's further announcements.

But on second thought, his heart sank.

After all, it seemed Zhang Guohuang had been looking for their classmates' names from right to left, and the further left he went, the higher the rank.

They hadn't called out Li Luo's name yet. Could it be that Li Luo still did better than him this time?

At this thought, Shao Heqi's expression turned a little ugly. He focused his attention, continuing to listen to Zhang Guohuang's announcements from within the crowd.

But as the ranks Zhang Guohuang called out got higher and higher, Shao Heqi's expression grew stranger and stranger.

Yan Zhusheng, rank 220... Wang Xinyu, rank 167... Ren Zheng, 149... Zhu Yufei, 128... Zhang Guohuang, 97... Shi Yanran, 83... Lu Jiahao, 47...

Li Luo's name wasn't there either!

As Shao Heqi thought this, his face suddenly lit up with joy, and he couldn't help but ask from outside the crowd, "What about Li Luo? Did you guys miss him earlier?"

After all, with the crowd packed in front of the bulletin board, it was very normal for Zhang Guohuang and Zhu Yufei to have overlooked a name.

The two had also fallen into a pattern of thinking, subconsciously assuming the class's top student had to be Lu Jiahao, so they hadn't bothered to look further up the list and really thought they might have missed it.

But after looking back through the list again, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang still couldn't find Li Luo's name.

Just then, Yan Zhusheng, who had been quietly watching from the side, suddenly raised her hand, pointed to the leftmost side of the bulletin board, and said, "Why don't you look at the top 40?"

As soon as she said this, the surrounding Class 8 students all looked at Yan Zhusheng, thinking to themselves that beauty truly is in the eye of the beholder.

Although everyone acknowledged that their class president was an outstanding person, it was more in terms of his overall character and abilities.

When it came to exam scores alone, Lu Jiahao, who managed to get into the school's top 50, was already considered a top-tier expert in a parallel class.

As for those who could push out the students from Class 1 and take up spots in the top 40, they were usually the prodigies from Classes 2 to 4 who had also been admitted through independent recruitment.

They might have just had an off day during the placement exams, which was why they were assigned to Classes 2, 3, or 4, but that didn't mean they were truly weaker than the students in Class 1.

But between the parallel classes and the key classes, there was practically a reproductive barrier; few could ever break through it.

For example, in this midterm exam for Class 8, a total of six students made it into the top 160, and the class's average score was already the second highest among all parallel classes.

And among the top 160, there were only about thirty-some students from the parallel classes.

Moreover, they were almost all ranked outside the top 100.

The number of prodigies from parallel classes who could break into the top 100 was barely more than ten.

Under these circumstances, you're saying a student from a parallel class could get into the top 40 and push down someone from Class 1?

Are you kidding me!

Especially Li Luo, who only ranked 328th in the entrance exam.

Shao Heqi would rather believe that the school had made a mistake entering Li Luo's scores and left him off the list.

But just then, Qiao Xinyan, who had finally squeezed to the front, glanced at her own rank and let out a sudden gasp:

"Holy crap! Li Luo is ranked 27th? How is he even higher than me?!"

"Who's Li Luo?" another student from Class 1 asked curiously.

"Ying Chanxi's cousin, the president of Class 8. You guys don't know?" Liu Shaowen said with his arms crossed, introducing and sighing to his Class 1 schoolmates. "I didn't expect him to be this amazing, getting such a high score while being in a parallel class. He really is Ying Chanxi's relative."

"I think I remember him."

"Didn't he sing a song during military training?"

"The one who bought drinks and ice cream for his entire class, right? A friend of mine was bragging to me about it."

Although many Class 1 students paid little attention to worldly affairs, some did have a slight impression of Li Luo, and with Liu Shaowen's reminder, they recalled who he was.

"Damn! When Teacher Sun was scolding us today, he said a student from a parallel class got into the top 40. He must have been talking about him, right?"

"Damn it all, why didn't a guy like that just take the independent recruitment exam properly? Why go to a parallel class and get us yelled at?"

The students from Class 1 grumbled indignantly.

Meanwhile, the students from Class 8 were already stunned.

Many of them still found it hard to believe.

As the crowd in front of the bulletin board thinned out, the students from Class 8 all squeezed to the front, looking towards the far-left side.

Li Luo, total score 954, rank 27.

Qiao Xinyan from Class 1 was ranked one place behind Li Luo, at 28th in the school.

Shao Heqi's mouth hung open, finding it hard to believe for a moment. He subconsciously took half a step back, feeling as if the name "Li Luo" was a giant sword that had cleaved him in two on the spot.

A score like that... how the hell did he get that?

The maximum possible score was only 1050!

"When did the class president get so badass?" Zhu Yufei stared at the ranking in shock and couldn't help but suck in a sharp breath. "Was he just messing around during the entrance exam?"

Beside him, Lu Jiahao gazed intently at Li Luo's name and rank. He suddenly felt a surge of motivation. After seeing the gap between himself and the class president, he turned around resolutely and walked towards the self-study classroom on the sixth floor.

He originally thought his only rivals were the students in the key classes, but now it seemed there was such a master in his own class.

Lu Jiahao's eyes were exceptionally serious, and he had already begun to replan his future study schedule.

The other students left in their own states of shock. The name of Li Luo, spread by the students of Class 8 and Class 1, gradually began to circulate among all the classes.

As a student from a parallel class, toppling a prodigy from Class 1... that sounded incredibly cool.

Currently, in the entire school, only Li Luo had accomplished this.

Below him, the closest to Class 1's level was a girl from Class 16 named Shen Shuhua, who ranked 43rd.

As for parallel class students who entered the top 50, apart from those two, there was only Lu Jiahao.

"Is this guy really that good?" Xie Shuchen looked at Li Luo's rank on the board and couldn't help but click his tongue. "He's almost catching up to me."

In this midterm exam, Liu Shaowen got 25th place, and Xie Shuchen got 17th, narrowly avoiding being surpassed by Li Luo.

Even so, Xie Shuchen still found it outrageous.

Liu Shaowen, at his side, also sighed with emotion. "Maybe this is just innate talent. Li Luo probably just goofed around too much in junior high. Once he started studying seriously in high school, he became truly unstoppable."

"He is Ying Chanxi's relative, after all," Xie Shuchen said, nodding in agreement.

Then, both of their gazes gradually shifted upwards, landing on the name ranked first in the entire school.

Ying Chanxi, total score 1014, first in the school.

She was also the only person in this first-year midterm exam to break the 1000-point barrier.

The second-place student behind her only had 998 points, a full 16 points lower!

"How on earth did she get that score?" Xie Shuchen grimaced, finding it hard to comprehend. "This is just too absurd."

"There are nine subjects in total." Liu Shaowen pointed to the subject-specific leaderboards on another part of the bulletin board, reminding him, "Ying Chanxi ranked first in the school in seven subjects, top ten in Chinese, and top three in Biology."

At this point, Liu Shaowen chuckled and patted Xie Shuchen's shoulder. "You'll get used to it. I was crushed by her for three whole years back at Yucai."

"Get used to it, my ass..." Jian Zhenyuan, the vice president of Class 1, stared resentfully at the board. The second-place rank with 998 points was him.

But he couldn't for the life of him figure out how he was supposed to make up the 16-point gap between him and Ying Chanxi.

"Zhusheng, Xiao Shu." Just then, Niu Qingling, a second-year student, walked over from the second-year building with Shao Youpeng. She called out to the two and waved. "Let's go, let's head to the club and get ready. The performance is about to start."

"Oh, right, where's Li Luo?"

"Aren't you in the same class as him, Zhusheng?"

"He's the class president," Yan Zhusheng said. "He has to help host the parent-teacher conference. He'll be over in a little while."

Shao Heqi, who was about to leave, felt a pang of misery upon hearing this.

The thought of that kid Li Luo getting 27th place and still being at the parent-teacher conference, where Teacher Kong would surely shower him with praise, made Shao Heqi's heart sour with envy.

He imagined the scene of all the parents' eyes focused on one person, and he felt like he could climax.

But the thought that the main character in this scene was that guy, Li Luo, made Shao Heqi burn with jealousy.

How infuriating!

He had thought he was already working hard enough.

But in the end... how had the gap between them actually grown wider?

(End of this chapter)
